lines.text: And you have slander'd nature in my form,
lines.plainText: And you have slander'd nature in my form

lines.text: Which, howsoever rude exteriorly,
lines.plainText: Which howsoever rude exteriorly

lines.text: Is yet the cover of a fairer mind
lines.plainText: Is yet the cover of a fairer mind

lines.text: Than to be butcher of an innocent child.
lines.plainText: Than to be butcher of an innocent child

lines.text: Doth Arthur live? O, haste thee to the peers,
lines.plainText: Doth Arthur live O haste thee to the peers

lines.text: Throw this report on their incensed rage,
lines.plainText: Throw this report on their incensed rage

lines.text: And make them tame to their obedience!
lines.plainText: And make them tame to their obedience

lines.text: Forgive the comment that my passion made
lines.plainText: Forgive the comment that my passion made

lines.text: Upon thy feature; for my rage was blind,
lines.plainText: Upon thy feature for my rage was blind

lines.text: And foul imaginary eyes of blood
lines.plainText: And foul imaginary eyes of blood

lines.text: Presented thee more hideous than thou art.
lines.plainText: Presented thee more hideous than thou art

lines.text: O, answer not, but to my closet bring
lines.plainText: O answer not but to my closet bring

lines.text: The angry lords with all expedient haste.
lines.plainText: The angry lords with all expedient haste

lines.text: I conjure thee but slowly; run more fast.
